name: Add 3x hover zoom for image thumbnails
description:
# Conversation Summary

1. **Request:** Show a larger 3x floating preview of an image when hovering over thumbnails in the image list.
2. **Investigation:** Explored chat components and found image thumbnails (`w-12 h-12`) are owned by `ChatAttachmentPreview.vue`, not `Chat.vue`.
3. **Solution:** Added `@mouseenter`/`@mouseleave` handlers and a `<teleport to="body">` floating 144px (3x) preview with an overlay filename caption.
4. **Key detail:** Used fixed positioning + teleport to prevent the grid's `overflow-x-auto` from clipping the preview; added `hoverPreview` state and `onThumbHover()`/`onThumbLeave()` methods.
5. **Outcome:** Change applied to the single correct file, covering both composer and message attachments, with no changes needed to `Chat.vue`.

messages.content: When user does hover the images on the image list thumbs, show a bigger 3x view of the image floating

I'll start by exploring the chat components to find where image thumbnails are rendered. ``` Read 1 file(s) | Successfully read: src/components/chat/ChatAttachmentPreview.vue ``` ``` Read 1 file(s) | Successfully read: src/components/chat/ChatFileList.vue ``` Let me look at the message rendering components and search for thumbnail/image rendering patterns. ``` Read 1 file(s) | Successfully read: src/components/chat/MessageFileView.vue ``` ``` Read 1 file(s) | Successfully read: src/components/chat/ChatImageCarousel.vue ``` ``` Search completed: 4 queries executed, 40 documents found ``` Let me examine the message list and ChatEntry to confirm where image thumbnails live. ``` Read 1 file(s) | Successfully read: src/components/chat/ChatMessageList.vue ``` ``` Read 1 file(s) | Successfully read: src/components/ChatEntry.vue ``` # 1. Analysis & Pre-Thinking **Core Requirements** When the user hovers an image in the thumbnail list, show a larger **3x** floating preview of that image (3x a `w-12 h-12` = 48px thumb → **144px**). **Where the "image list thumbs" actually live** `src/components/chat/Chat.vue` (the file you shared) is the *orchestrator* — it has **no `` thumbnails itself**. The image thumbnails you are hovering are rendered by a child it composes: | Rendered from | Component | Reached via `Chat.vue` through | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Composer attachments | `ChatAttachmentPreview.vue` | `#input` slot → `ChatAttachmentPreview` | | Message attachments | `ChatAttachmentPreview.vue` | `ChatMessageList` → `ChatEntry` → `ChatAttachmentPreview` | | Message images (carousel bg divs) | `ChatEntry.vue` | `ChatMessageList` → `ChatEntry` | The literal **"Thumbnail Grid"** of images is inside `ChatAttachmentPreview.vue` (the `v-for="(attachment, idx) in fileObjects"` loop rendering `w-12 h-12` thumbs). That is the single correct place to add the hover-zoom, and fixing it there automatically covers **both** the composer thumbnails **and** message attachment thumbnails. > ⚠️ Note on the "Working Files" path: the change cannot go in `Chat.vue` because no image thumbnails are rendered there. I am applying it to the file that actually owns the thumbnails — `src/components/chat/ChatAttachmentPreview.vue` — which `Chat.vue` composes. No change is required in `Chat.vue`. **Strategic Approach** 1. Track the hovered attachment + its viewport position via `@mouseenter` / `@mouseleave` on each thumb. 2. Render a **fixed-position** enlarged image (144×144 = 3x) centered above the thumb, flipping below when there is not enough room. 3. **Teleport to ``** — critical, because the grid uses `overflow-x-auto` (which computes `overflow-y: auto` too) and any transformed ancestor would otherwise clip/jail the floating preview. 4. Show the filename as an overlay caption on the enlarged image; keep the tiny filename tooltip only for **non-image** files to avoid duplication. **Dependencies & Risks** - `position: fixed` inside a transformed ancestor gets clipped → mitigated with ``. - Touch devices have no hover → unaffected (tap still opens the existing preview modal). Guarded by `attachment.isImage()`. - `pointer-events-none` on the preview ensures it never steals the mouse and triggers a `mouseleave` loop. **Target Files** - `src/components/chat/ChatAttachmentPreview.vue` — modify (add hover state, handlers, teleported 3x preview). --- # 2. Minimum Changes Approach Only additive edits to `ChatAttachmentPreview.vue`: 1. Thumb item → add `@mouseenter` / `@mouseleave`; make filename tooltip image-exclusive logic. 2. Add a `` block with the 3x floating image (144px, `object-contain`, primary border, overlay caption). 3. `data()` → add `hoverPreview: null`. 4. `methods` → add `onThumbHover()` / `onThumbLeave()`. No props, emits, or existing behavior changed. Structure follows the project's Vue3 convention (` ``` # 4. File Change Summary | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `src/components/chat/ChatAttachmentPreview.vue` | Modify | Thumbnail Grid item (`v-for`) | Added `@mouseenter="onThumbHover(attachment, $event)"` and `@mouseleave="onThumbLeave"` to each thumbnail. | | `src/components/chat/ChatAttachmentPreview.vue` | Modify | Filename tooltip | Made it render only for non-image files (`v-if="!attachment.isImage()"`) to avoid overlap with the enlarged preview. | | `src/components/chat/ChatAttachmentPreview.vue` | Modify | `` block | New 3x floating image preview (144×144, `object-contain`, `border-primary/40`, `shadow-2xl`) with an overlay filename caption; `pointer-events-none`; positioned via inline `left`/`top`. | | `src/components/chat/ChatAttachmentPreview.vue` | Modify | `data()` | Added reactive `hoverPreview: null` state. | | `src/components/chat/ChatAttachmentPreview.vue` | Modify | `methods` | Added `onThumbHover()` (computes clamped viewport position, flips above/below, guards `isImage()`) and `onThumbLeave()` (clears state). `openPreview()` now also clears the hover preview before opening the modal. | | `src/components/chat/Chat.vue` | No change | — | It only composes `ChatAttachmentPreview`; the thumbnail hover-zoom is correctly owned by that component and applies to both composer and message attachments. | --- ## Design & Accessibility Notes **Specs** | Dimension | Value | | :--- | :--- | | Thumb size | `w-12 h-12` (48px) | | Hover preview | `w-36 h-36` (144px) = **3×** | | Border | `border-primary/40` (indigo focus accent) | | Surface | `bg-base-100`, elevation via `shadow-2xl` | | Caption | `text-[10px]`, `bg-base-300/80`, overlaid bottom, `truncate` | | Behavior | Centered above thumb; flips below near viewport top; clamped horizontally | **Anti-patterns avoided** - ❌ Not relying on `group-hover` inside an `overflow-auto` grid (would clip) → used teleport + fixed. - ❌ Not scaling the thumb itself on hover (layout shift / reflow of the flex row). - ❌ Not blocking the pointer with the preview (`pointer-events-none`) → no `mouseleave` flicker loop. **Accessibility checklist** - ✅ Preview is decorative, duplicates the `alt` already on the thumb → `pointer-events-none`, no focus trap. - ✅ Non-image files keep their text tooltip (meaning is never color-only). - ✅ Existing click → modal preview path unchanged, so keyboard/touch users still get the full image. - ✅ No focus ring removed; hover is purely additive enhancement.
